items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Theorem (named 'Chevalley's Theorem'): for a quasi-compact and locally of finite presentation morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, the image of every etale locally constructible subset of |X| is etale locally constructible in |Y| (source lines 5936-5943). The proof reduces to the scheme case: given E and an affine V etale over Y, one only has to show that the preimage of f(E) in V is constructible; quasi-compactness of f makes V x_Y X quasi-compact, an affine etale U -> V x_Y X then identifies the preimage of f(E) in V with the image under U -> V of the preimage of E in U, and the scheme case of Chevalley's theorem applies to U -> V.
